record_note: Wired by hand on 2026-09-19 (commit 61dac7f, 'process: plunk in the gate (ruff + pytest + fresh-venv run + version invariant)'), before the kit existed as a git repo — so `revision` is the kit's FIRST PUBLISHED commit, not the exact copy point; do not read it as the tree this repo was copied from. The hooks and the gate script are byte-identical to the kit's: the gate script's one divergence was a kit fix that landed after the copy, and it was synced in on 2026-09-20, so nothing here is adapted by hand any more. The kit's C++ and Deno artifacts (tools/ci.sh, .ci.env.example, templates/deno/gate.sh, .gitignore) never applied to this Python repo and are not listed; ruff.toml, mypy.ini, pytest.ini and .gitignore here are this repo's own files, not kit copies. Rule that keeps this file true: any commit that edits a copied artifact must update that artifact's repo_sha256 in the same commit.
